description: Google Maps places for a query in a country or around coordinates: up to 100 places with rank, name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count, coordinates, price level and place id (no reviews or photos), from Google Maps, $0.018 a call. Use when building local-SEO or lead lists, or checking who ranks in a local search. No places is an empty answer, which is still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.018 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

coordinates.description: Search around a point instead of a country: lat,lng or lat,lng,zoom: latitude -90..90, longitude -180..180 (up to 7 decimals), zoom 3-21 (default 14).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (us, gb, de, ...; uk = gb). Default us. Leave out when coordinates are given.

lang.description: Language code (with a country: one offered for it; with coordinates: a Google language code). Default: the country's main language when offered, else en.

q.description: What to look for (e.g. coffee shop), at most 200 characters.

name: google_maps_search
title: Google Maps places (up to 100)
